project.name: cartridges
project.description: Training and serving platform for journal cartridges: OCR fine-tuning of handwritten journals, a Task Store of questions, a vLLM Teacher on Modal that labels them, distillation of the Teacher into a trainable KV-cache cartridge, and a LibreChat gateway that serves Teacher or cartridge. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

nodes.summary: Modal GPU class serving the Qwen OCR model for handwritten page transcription with torch and transformers.

nodes.name: get_cached

nodes.name: put_cached
nodes.summary: Upserts a transcription row with optional source path and mtime for auditability.

nodes.name: SourceFile

nodes.name: PageRow

nodes.name: PostgresPageStore
nodes.summary: Async autocommit store for the batch pipeline exposing get/put of source files and OCR page rows over the v2 tables.

nodes.name: dates.py
nodes.summary: Rule-based reader of handwritten entry dates from OCR page text, resolving OCR-misread years and months per document with a dynamic-programming pass over the journal timeline and labelling every page as dated, continued, unsure, or estimated.

nodes.name: outputs.py
nodes.summary: Output writers for the batch OCR pipeline: per-PDF transcript.md, PageIndex heading tree (markdown and JSON), and manifest.json, plus collate() which joins all transcripts into a single timeline-ordered teacher_context.md with stable page anchors.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads cache rows only and is deterministic; collate() lazily imports batch.timeline to avoid a circular import with timeline.py.

nodes.name: timeline.py
nodes.summary: Builds one timeline across all journal transcripts in an output directory by grouping pages into dated entries and heap-merging journals by date, writing timeline.md and a PageIndex tree JSON with page-range indices.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses heapq to interleave journals while preserving each journal's page order; recursive helpers fill start/end page ranges and number tree nodes.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel for datagen that re-exports the LOADERS registry and convert_file from loaders.

nodes.name: flows.py
nodes.summary: Prefect tasks and the prepare-data flow that convert a journal PDF to markdown page by page: counts pages, OCRs each page with a cached engine, optionally extracts dates with a Modal-hosted model, merges with existing sections, and writes the result (or delegates to the agent pipeline).
nodes.languageNotes: Prefect @task/@flow decorators; heavy dependencies (loaders, extraction, cache, agent pipeline) are imported lazily inside tasks so the flow module stays importable without them.

nodes.name: WrittenDate
nodes.summary: NamedTuple for a date as written on a page: month and day (trusted), optional year and weekday (evidence only), and the raw month text for misread repair.

nodes.name: read_date
nodes.summary: Scans the first header lines of a page's OCR text for a written date using month-name and numeric patterns, returning a WrittenDate or None.

nodes.name: resolve_years
nodes.summary: Dynamic-programming pass over all dated pages that chooses a year (and possibly a repaired month) per page, minimizing costs for backward jumps, weekday mismatches, and deviations from the written year.

nodes.name: page_dates
nodes.summary: Labels every page with an ISO date plus a (cont.), (?), or (est.) marker, or 'unknown', by combining read_date and resolve_years across the document.

nodes.name: _month_variants
nodes.summary: Returns the set of months one plausible OCR misread away from the written month text (e.g. '11' for '1'), used for month repair.

nodes.name: transcript_md
nodes.summary: Renders page tuples into the golden transcript format, one formatted page section per page separated by '---'.

nodes.name: pageindex
nodes.summary: Builds the PageIndex heading markdown and matching tree JSON for one document, escaping OCR headings so only page headings become nodes.

nodes.name: write_document
nodes.summary: Writes transcript.md, pageindex.md, pageindex_tree.json, and manifest.json for one PDF into its output directory from cached page rows.

nodes.name: collate
nodes.summary: Joins all per-document transcripts into teacher_context.md in timeline order with [doc:p.N] anchors and reports an estimated token count against a budget.

nodes.name: Entry
nodes.summary: Dataclass for one journal entry: journal name, date label, marker, and its (page number, text) pages, with a computed title spanning the page range.

nodes.name: read_entries
nodes.summary: Parses a transcript.md into Entry objects by splitting on page headers and grouping continuation pages under the preceding dated page.

nodes.name: timeline_entries
nodes.summary: Reads every <out>/*/transcript.md and merges their entries by date with a heap, keeping each journal's page order.

nodes.name: page_labels
nodes.summary: Returns the date label for each page of an entry, marking continuation pages after the first.

nodes.name: build_timeline
nodes.summary: Writes timeline.md (year > month > entry headings) and timeline_pageindex_tree.json for all journals in an output directory.

nodes.name: ensure_transcription_cache
nodes.summary: Prefect task that initializes the Postgres transcription cache schema before OCR runs.

nodes.name: extract_page_text
nodes.summary: Prefect task that OCRs one PDF page with the selected engine and model at the given DPI, logging progress.

nodes.name: extract_page_date
nodes.summary: Prefect task that asks the Modal-hosted date extractor for the written date on a page's text.

nodes.name: convert_document
nodes.summary: Prefect task that converts a whole document to markdown via the loaders registry starting at a given page.

nodes.name: merge_markdown_sections
nodes.summary: Merges newly generated markdown page sections with sections already present in an existing output file.

nodes.name: assert_section_count
nodes.summary: Validates that the generated markdown has the expected number of page sections, raising ValueError otherwise.

nodes.name: run_agent_prepare_data
nodes.summary: Prefect task delegating the whole prepare-data job to the async agent pipeline.

nodes.name: prepare_data_flow
nodes.summary: Prefect flow orchestrating PDF-to-markdown preparation: cache init, page counting, per-page OCR and date extraction, section merging, validation, and writing, or agent-based processing when requested.

nodes.name: ask.py
nodes.summary: Modal GPU function that answers a question with the base model plus a trained cartridge (no journal in context), resolving the cartridge from local files, the Modal volume, or a W&B artifact and logging the ask as a W&B eval run.
nodes.languageNotes: Modal app with @app.function GPU execution and a @app.local_entrypoint; heavy imports deferred inside functions so the local side stays light.

nodes.name: prompt_ids
nodes.summary: Renders the student's prompt token ids using the shared teacher answer-message format (citation reminder then question) without the context block.

nodes.name: ask
nodes.summary: Remote GPU entrypoint: loads the cartridge and base model, generates an answer, parses citations, and records timing, size, and cost in a tracked W&B eval run.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: Local-side helper that ships a local cartridge's files (or passes a reference through) and invokes ask remotely inside app.run().

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Modal local entrypoint printing the JSON result of a remote ask.

nodes.name: cache.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Cartridge: a trainable KV prefix for attention layers plus initial conv/recurrent states for Gated DeltaNet linear-attention layers of a frozen qwen3_5 model, with prefill initialization, HF DynamicCache integration, generation, and safetensors save/load.
nodes.languageNotes: Subclasses HF cache layers (DynamicLayer, LinearAttentionLayer) so gradients flow into the cached tensors instead of being clobbered by in-place copy_ updates.

nodes.name: _CartridgeLinearLayer
nodes.summary: Linear-attention cache layer that replaces (rather than copies in place) conv and recurrent states so autograd can differentiate through the cartridge's initial states.

nodes.name: CartridgeCache
nodes.summary: DynamicCache subclass whose layers are pre-populated with the cartridge's tensors for the HF forward pass.

nodes.name: Cartridge
nodes.summary: nn.Module holding per-layer trainable keys/values and linear-layer states; supports init_from_text prefill, as_past_key_values, forward, sampling generate, and directory save/load with metadata.

nodes.name: sample
nodes.summary: Temperature and top-p sampling over logits with an optional torch Generator for reproducibility.

nodes.name: grpo.py
nodes.summary: Stage-2 asynchronous GRPO training of cartridge tensors: a generation thread samples reward-scored groups into a bounded staleness-aware buffer while the trainer applies a token-level clipped importance-ratio loss and periodically syncs weights.
nodes.languageNotes: Async producer/consumer on one GPU via threading.Thread and a bounded queue.Queue; pydantic config with extra='forbid'; dataclass Group as the rollout record.

nodes.name: GRPOConfig
nodes.summary: Pydantic config for GRPO: group size, steps, sampling, learning rate, clip bounds, staleness, sync cadence, and queue size.

nodes.name: Group
nodes.summary: Dataclass for one rollout group: prompt ids, completions, behavior logprobs, rewards, advantages, and policy version.

nodes.name: group_advantages
nodes.summary: Computes group-relative advantages (r - mean) / (std + eps).

nodes.name: grpo_loss
nodes.summary: Token-level PPO/DAPO-style clipped importance-ratio loss with no KL term, normalized by completion tokens, returning loss and clip-fraction metrics.

nodes.name: pad_completions
nodes.summary: Right-pads variable-length completions into one tensor plus a mask.

nodes.name: sequence_logprobs
nodes.summary: Runs the model with the cartridge as past key values and returns per-token logprobs of the completions under the current policy.

nodes.name: encode_prompt
nodes.summary: Tokenizes a question into the shared answer prompt format.

nodes.name: trim_eos
nodes.summary: Truncates a completion at the first EOS token id.

nodes.name: RolloutBuffer
nodes.summary: Bounded queue of rollout groups with backpressure on put and staleness-based dropping on get.

nodes.name: GenerationWorker
nodes.summary: Daemon thread that samples G completions per prompt with its own cartridge copy, scores them with the reward fn, and publishes groups; receives weight syncs via publish.

nodes.name: train_grpo
nodes.summary: Main async GRPO loop: starts the generation worker, pulls groups, steps AdamW on the cartridge, syncs weights every N steps, and reports metrics via log/on_step callbacks.

nodes.name: qgen.py
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the question-generator eval as one strictly sequential process: probe the Teacher, optionally classify and seed, synthesize, top up short task kinds, build answer pairs, and always stop the Teacher; every step is injected for testability.
nodes.languageNotes: Every phase is passed in as a callable so tests substitute fakes; a finally block guarantees the Teacher session is stopped.

nodes.name: probe
nodes.summary: Spawns one Teacher call and polls for its result with periodic logging, cancelling the call on timeout or any error so no queued input starts a container later.

nodes.name: topup_mix
nodes.summary: Weights the short task kinds by their shortfall into a kind-mix, or None if nothing is short.

nodes.name: qgen_eval
nodes.summary: Runs probe, classify, seed, synthesize, shortfall top-up, and pairs in order, collecting reports and stopping the Teacher in a finally block.

nodes.name: cli.py
nodes.summary: Fire-based command-line interface exposing the whole platform: data prep and OCR, model eval/promote/merge, Modal serving and gateway, notes processing, cartridge train/sweep/ask, and the Task Store lifecycle (init, seed, synthesize, qgen-eval, label, export, stats).
nodes.languageNotes: Single Cli class with ~37 subcommand methods dispatched by python-fire; subcommand bodies lazily import heavy modules (torch, modal, wandb) so the CLI starts quickly.

nodes.name: Cli
nodes.summary: Command surface for cartridges: each public method is a subcommand (prepare_data, ocr, serve_deploy, cartridge_train, tasks_label, eval_judge, ...) that wires config constants to the underlying pipeline modules.

nodes.name: _download_shards
nodes.summary: Downloads Modal volume or W&B shard URIs into a local cache directory.

nodes.name: _seed
nodes.summary: Seeds the Task Store with human questions from a file, optionally replacing and skipping templates.

nodes.name: _synthesize
nodes.summary: Runs one synthesis pass against the Teacher for n tasks with a seed, corpus, group, and kind mix.

nodes.name: _classify_chats
nodes.summary: Classifies imported chat prompts with the Teacher (no-context batch) and records hits for promotion.

nodes.name: _promote_chats
nodes.summary: Promotes classified chats into train/eval splits using the given ratios and seed.

nodes.name: _log_targets
nodes.summary: Logs label targets for a run to W&B tracking.

nodes.name: _tasks_stop
nodes.summary: Stops the Teacher containers started by this session by id.

nodes.name: _tasks_run
nodes.summary: Records a Task Store generation run row for a component with its model, group, and config.

nodes.name: _pdf_paths
nodes.summary: Expands file and directory arguments into a list of PDF paths.

nodes.name: _require_deployed
nodes.summary: Checks that the serving function for a revision is deployed on Modal and fails fast otherwise.

nodes.name: _load_split
nodes.summary: Loads a dataset split from a dataset directory for evaluation.

nodes.name: _eval_served
nodes.summary: Evaluates a deployed serving revision on a dataset split with the given concurrency and scores the predictions.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Console-script entry: configures logging and hands Cli to fire.

nodes.name: pipeline.py
nodes.summary: Agent-driven prepare-data workflow: runs the Claude Agent SDK with the prepare-data skill and the in-process MCP OCR tools to convert a PDF into golden-format markdown.

nodes.name: prepare_data
nodes.summary: Initializes the page cache, configures ClaudeAgentOptions with the prepare_data MCP server and skill, and streams the agent's text output to the log.

nodes.name: tools.py
nodes.summary: In-process MCP server exposing page-granular PDF tools to the prepare-data agent: count pages, rasterize a page, OCR a page (PaddleOCR or deployed model), and append a transcribed page to the markdown output with date carry-forward.
nodes.languageNotes: Tools are declared with the claude_agent_sdk @tool decorator and bundled via create_sdk_mcp_server; module-level dicts cache rasterized pages and per-file state.

nodes.name: list_pdf_pages
nodes.summary: MCP tool returning the page count of a PDF.

nodes.name: pdf_page_to_image
nodes.summary: MCP tool rasterizing one 1-indexed PDF page to a PNG file with bounds checking.

nodes.name: ocr_pdf_page
nodes.summary: MCP tool running OCR on one PDF page via PaddleOCR or a deployed model, with cache keys from the source path and mtime.

nodes.name: append_page
nodes.summary: MCP tool appending a '## p. N - date: D' block to the output markdown, carrying the last seen date forward and recreating the file on the first call.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package barrel re-exporting configure_logging as the logging helpers' public API.

nodes.name: config.py
nodes.summary: Single place to configure stdlib logging with a timestamped level/name format; modules only call getLogger(__name__).

nodes.name: configure_logging
nodes.summary: Calls logging.basicConfig with the shared format, date format, and level.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for the batch OCR subsystem; a docstring points to the batch-ocr-pipeline plan.

nodes.name: backends.py
nodes.summary: Defines the OcrBackend protocol and OcrServiceBackend, an async httpx client that sends one page image to the packaged OCR service's /ocr endpoint and reads the served model id from /info.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a typing.Protocol for structural typing and httpx follow_redirects to survive Modal's 150 s HTTP limit (303 to a result URL).

nodes.name: keys.py
nodes.summary: Deterministic BLAKE2b cache keys for the batch OCR pipeline: file_key hashes PDF bytes and page_key hashes (file_key, page number, DPI).

nodes.name: pipeline.py
nodes.summary: Batch OCR pipeline: describes PDFs, skips cached pages, renders pages in a process pool into a bounded queue, transcribes them with N async OCR workers, and stores one PageRow per page with loop detection and retries.
nodes.languageNotes: Producer/consumer design with asyncio.Queue backpressure, ProcessPoolExecutor for CPU-bound rendering, asyncio.TaskGroup for workers, and pydantic/dataclass report models.

nodes.name: evaluate.py
nodes.summary: Evaluates the served OCR model on the labeled split through the same /ocr endpoint as production, computing corpus CER, median CER, and loop rate into an EvalReport.

nodes.name: loops.py
nodes.summary: Pure-Python detection of the repetition-loop failure in OCR transcriptions: ends_in_loop checks whether a text ends in a repeated phrase and loop_rate aggregates it across pages, forgiving loops present in the reference.

nodes.name: metrics.py
nodes.summary: Transcription quality metrics: corpus_cer (total character edits over total reference characters via jiwer) and mean_ned (mean normalized Levenshtein distance per page).

nodes.name: OcrBackend
nodes.summary: Protocol for an OCR backend: model_id() returns the served model id (cache key) and transcribe(png) returns the text of one page image.

nodes.name: OcrServiceBackend
nodes.summary: httpx-based OcrBackend that posts base64 PNGs to the OCR service's /ocr endpoint with bearer auth, caches /info, and follows Modal result-URL redirects.

nodes.name: file_key
nodes.summary: Streams a file in 1 MiB chunks into a BLAKE2b-256 digest and returns the hex key.

nodes.name: page_key
nodes.summary: Hashes file_key, page number, and DPI into a BLAKE2b-256 page cache key.

nodes.name: PageStore
nodes.summary: Protocol for the page cache store: get/put source-file records and get/put page rows keyed by page key and model key.

nodes.name: Doc
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing one PDF: resolved path, file_key, and the tuple of per-page cache keys.

nodes.name: Job
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for one page to OCR: its Doc, page number, and page key.

nodes.name: PageFailure
nodes.summary: Pydantic record of a page that failed rendering or OCR after all attempts.

nodes.name: DocReport
nodes.summary: Pydantic per-document counters: pages, cached, processed, looped, failed.

nodes.name: RunReport
nodes.summary: Pydantic run summary with model identity, DPI, per-doc reports, failures, elapsed time, and an ok property that is True when nothing failed or looped.

nodes.name: render_png
nodes.summary: Rasterizes one PDF page to PNG bytes with pymupdf at the given DPI; module-level so the process pool can pickle it.

nodes.name: describe_doc
nodes.summary: Builds a Doc for a PDF, reusing the stored SourceFile record when size and mtime match, otherwise hashing the file and counting pages, then deriving all page keys.

nodes.name: process
nodes.summary: Top-level batch entry: plans jobs from cache misses, verifies the server serves the expected model id, runs the render/OCR workers, optionally writes per-document outputs, and returns a RunReport.

nodes.name: _run_jobs
nodes.summary: Runs the producer/consumer loop: render tasks feed a bounded PNG queue, async workers transcribe with exponential-backoff retries, flag looped pages, and persist each PageRow as it completes.

nodes.name: Prediction
nodes.summary: Pydantic record of one eval page: reference, hypothesis, per-page CER, and ok/error status.

nodes.name: EvalReport
nodes.summary: Pydantic eval summary: model identity, split, counts, corpus and median CER, loop rate, timing, and all predictions.

nodes.name: score
nodes.summary: Computes the EvalReport metric fields from references and hypotheses: per-page predictions, error count, corpus CER, median CER, and loop rate.

nodes.name: transcribe_all
nodes.summary: Sends every image to the backend once under a concurrency semaphore; failures yield None without retry so server faults show up in the eval.

nodes.name: ends_in_loop
nodes.summary: Returns True if the text ends with a phrase of up to max_phrase_words repeated back-to-back at least min_repeats times, allowing a trailing partial copy.

nodes.name: loop_rate
nodes.summary: Share of non-None transcriptions that end in a loop, not counting loops the reference text itself ends with.

nodes.name: corpus_cer
nodes.summary: Aggregates character edits across all scored pages with jiwer and returns corpus CER plus counts of scored and blank-reference pages.

nodes.name: mean_ned
nodes.summary: Mean normalized Levenshtein distance per page over pages with a hypothesis and non-empty reference.

nodes.name: chunks.py
nodes.summary: Samples random token-bounded runs of consecutive journal pages from the timeline (teacher_context.md) as Chunk objects with page citations and char spans, and builds/validates grounded teacher QA pairs about a chunk. Chunks are Passage-compatible so datagen.qa's Teacher and verify accept them unchanged.
nodes.languageNotes: Frozen dataclasses; chunks duck-type datagen.qa.Passage (same citations/pages/text fields).

nodes.name: Chunk
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass for a run of consecutive timeline pages: id, text, citations, pages, date range and char span into teacher_context.md.

nodes.name: _Page
nodes.summary: Internal frozen dataclass for one timeline page with its citation, label, text and offset in teacher_context.md.

nodes.name: timeline_pages
nodes.summary: Walks the batch timeline entries and returns every page in order as _Page records with offsets into teacher_context.md.

nodes.name: sample_chunks
nodes.summary: Draws n random runs of consecutive pages whose token count falls within [min_tokens, max_tokens], optionally excluding held-out pages, using a seeded RNG for reproducibility.

nodes.name: _chunk
nodes.summary: Builds a Chunk from a list of pages: joins sections, derives citations, date range and the char span.

nodes.name: qa_messages
nodes.summary: Formats the datagen.qa PROMPT for a chunk into a one-message teacher conversation asking for n QA pairs.

nodes.name: grounded_qa
nodes.summary: Parses the teacher's JSON reply (stripping think tags and fences) and keeps only pairs that pass datagen.qa.verify against the chunk.

nodes.name: data.py
nodes.summary: Builds the cartridge's training datasets: self-study conversations (Bot A seeds a user turn from a chunk, Bot B answers with the full timeline and top-k logprobs as distillation targets) and grounded QA pairs for GRPO, with quality stats, a manifest and upload to the Modal cartridge-cache volume.
nodes.languageNotes: generate is an injectable callable (modal_generate for the deployed Teacher, a fake in tests); Modal and teacher imports are lazy so the module imports without Modal.

nodes.name: build_selfstudy
nodes.summary: Runs the two-bot self-study loop over chunks: seed prompts to Bot A at temperature 0.6, then Bot B answers with context and returns top-k logprobs; yields train_distill Example rows with chunk, kind and grounding info.

nodes.name: build_qa
nodes.summary: Asks the teacher for QA pairs per chunk, keeps grounded ones via chunks.grounded_qa and dedupes by normalized question text.

nodes.name: quality_stats
nodes.summary: Computes summary statistics over self-study rows and QA pairs: grounding rates, citation parsing, per-kind counts, page coverage and held-out leakage checks.

nodes.name: write_jsonl
nodes.summary: Writes a list of dict rows to a JSONL file, creating parent directories.

nodes.name: modal_generate
nodes.summary: Wraps the deployed Modal Teacher as a generate callable: one spawned call per conversation via teacher.generate_all, returning the first completion or None.

nodes.name: build_datasets
nodes.summary: End-to-end dataset build: samples chunks, builds self-study and QA sets, writes JSONL files locally, computes quality stats, writes a manifest and uploads artifacts to the Modal volume.

nodes.name: upload
nodes.summary: Copies local files to /data/<key> on the cartridges-cartridge-cache Modal volume using a batch upload.

nodes.name: upload_eval_sets
nodes.summary: Uploads eval's qa_heldout*.jsonl files to the volume's /data/eval/ directory for the training pipeline's evals.

nodes.name: selfstudy.py
nodes.summary: Self-study seed prompts (Cartridges paper section 4.1) adapted from HazyResearch/cartridges: four seed families (summarization, question, use_case, creative) phrased in the author's first-person voice, each asking for JSON with question, citations and verbatim evidence that parse_seed_reply grounds against the chunk.
nodes.languageNotes: Seed variants are drawn from random.Random seeded by (seed, chunk.id), so prompts are deterministic per chunk.

nodes.name: _summarization
nodes.summary: Picks a seeded variant of the summarization seed prompt asking for a first-person recap of a period in the chunk.

nodes.name: _question
nodes.summary: Picks a seeded variant of the question seed prompt asking what the author did, said or who they were with.

nodes.name: _use_case
nodes.summary: Picks a seeded variant of the use-case seed prompt framing a practical request grounded in the chunk.

nodes.name: SeedPrompt
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass holding a seed kind, chunk id and the system+user messages sent to Bot A.

nodes.name: seed_prompts
nodes.summary: Builds one SeedPrompt per kind for a chunk, with the chunk in the system prompt and a deterministic variant per (seed, chunk.id).

nodes.name: parse_seed_reply
nodes.summary: Parses Bot A's JSON reply into {question, citations, evidence, grounded}, checking citations are chunk pages and evidence fuzzy-matches cited page text via rapidfuzz.

nodes.name: qa.py
nodes.summary: Generates script-checkable question/answer pairs from journal passages: Passage groups consecutive pages of one timeline entry, Teacher asks an OpenAI-compatible chat model (e.g. vLLM) for JSON pairs, and verify keeps only pairs whose citations are passage pages and whose evidence fuzzy-matches a cited page.
nodes.languageNotes: Teacher drops its OpenAI client in __getstate__ so instances pickle into DataLoader workers; EVIDENCE_MIN_SCORE (rapidfuzz partial_ratio 90) is shared with selfstudy.

nodes.name: Passage
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass of consecutive pages from one journal with derived id, citations and teacher_context.md-style text.

nodes.name: passages
nodes.summary: Splits each timeline entry into runs of pages bounded by max_chars/min_chars and returns them as Passage objects.

nodes.name: Teacher
nodes.summary: Callable that prompts an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for pairs_per_passage JSON QA pairs about a passage, lazily creating the client from TEACHER_API_KEY.

nodes.name: verify
nodes.summary: Checks a QA pair has the required fields, a valid answer_type, citations that are passage pages, and evidence that fuzzy-matches a cited page's text.

nodes.name: qa_dataset.py
nodes.summary: Torch IterableDataset that endlessly samples random passages, asks the teacher for QA pairs and yields the ones that pass datagen.qa.verify, with per-worker seeding for parallel DataLoader workers.
nodes.languageNotes: Infinite IterableDataset; use DataLoader(batch_size=None) and itertools.islice to bound it.

nodes.name: QAPairs
nodes.summary: IterableDataset wrapping passages and a teacher callable; __iter__ seeds an RNG per worker and yields verified pair dicts with passage_id and date.

nodes.name: playwright.yml

tour.description: Start with the README, which documents only the legacy `cartridges prepare-data` Prefect flow, then move to `cli.py`, the real map of the platform: a `fire`-based CLI whose methods are the runbook for everything that follows (serve_deploy, notes_process/timeline/collate, tasks_*, cartridge_train, cartridge_ask, gateway_serve). `pyproject.toml` wires that module up as the `cartridges` console script and lists the stack (Modal, vLLM, FastAPI, Prefect, Postgres, torch/transformers, wandb), while the Makefile wraps the common invocations and the LibreChat lifecycle. Keep `docs/plans/cartridge-pipeline.md` open as the narrative contract: self-study distillation of a Teacher into a KV-cache cartridge, followed by async GRPO.
tour.languageLesson: Python `fire` turns a class's public methods into subcommands automatically: `cartridges tasks_label --limit 50` calls `Cli.tasks_label(limit=50)`. The CLI imports heavy modules lazily inside each method, which is why the static import graph from cli.py reaches only the logging package even though it drives the whole system.

tour.title: OCR Fine-Tuning and the OCR Service
tour.description: The data pipeline begins with handwritten journal scans, so the first ML component is an OCR model. `training/finetune.py` is a Modal app that LoRA-fine-tunes a vision-language model with unsloth, logs to W&B, and runs k-fold and loop-rate evals, driven by the Pydantic configs in `training/config.py`. `serve/recipe.py` then freezes everything about how a page becomes text (model SHA, preprocessing, prompt, decoding, postprocessing) into an immutable `OcrRecipe` whose hash is the served model id; `serve/registry.py` promotes verified SHAs on the HF Hub to a prod tag, and `serve/vllm_server.py` packages vLLM behind a FastAPI `/ocr` endpoint on Modal.
tour.languageLesson: Modal apps declare their GPU image, volumes and functions as decorators on ordinary Python; `@app.function(gpu=...)` runs remotely while `@app.local_entrypoint()` runs on your machine. Note that config.py keeps paths as `str` rather than `Path` so the Pydantic models pickle cleanly across the Modal boundary.

tour.title: Journal PDFs to Timeline
tour.description: With an OCR service deployed, `batch/pipeline.py` turns whole journal PDFs into text: it renders pages in a process pool into a bounded queue, fans them out to N async OCR workers, detects repetition loops, retries, and stores one `PageRow` per page. `storage/cache.py` is the Postgres layer under it, a content-addressed cache keyed on (page_hash, model_id) plus the `source_files` and `ocr_pages` tables, so re-running never re-OCRs a page. `batch/timeline.py` and `batch/outputs.py` then date the pages, heap-merge all journals into one chronological `timeline.md`, and collate them into `teacher_context.md` with stable page anchors, which is the single document the Teacher in Step 5 will hold in its context.
tour.languageLesson: Producer/consumer with `asyncio.Queue(maxsize=N)` gives back-pressure for free: CPU-bound page rendering runs in a `ProcessPoolExecutor` while I/O-bound OCR calls run as async workers, and the bounded queue keeps memory flat regardless of PDF size.

tour.title: The Task Store
tour.description: Training a cartridge needs questions, and the Task Store is where they live. `docs/plans/task-db.md` is the design doc; `tasks/types.py` (the highest fan-in file in the repo) defines the frozen Pydantic records (Corpus, Page, GenRun, Task, Label, Sample) and their Literal kinds, origins and splits, and `tasks/store.py` is the only module allowed to talk to Postgres. Three ingestion paths populate it: `seed.py` turns the user's own questions into origin 'human' tasks, `chats.py` mines ChatGPT history for real prompts, and `psych.py` loads psychology instruments as framework_lens tasks.
tour.languageLesson: Frozen Pydantic models (`model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True)`) plus `Literal[...]` fields make the task taxonomy a type-checked vocabulary: an invalid kind or split fails at construction, not deep inside a training run. Funnelling all SQL through one module keeps the schema idempotent and testable with a FakeStore.

tour.title: Synthesizing and Sampling Tasks
tour.description: Human seeds alone are too few, so `tasks/synthesize.py` plans recipes (kind, style, focus page chunks, exemplars), prompts the journal-context model, parses JSON-schema drafts and validates them before inserting new tasks; `tasks/validate.py` holds the shared checks. `tasks/sampler.py` is the deliberately pure counterpart: a deterministic, stratified selection by split, kind mix and framework using largest-remainder quotas and a canonical query hash, so the same query always yields the same training set. `tasks/psych.py` rounds out the origins with held-out psychology instruments.
tour.languageLesson: Keeping the sampler free of I/O (it takes rows, returns rows) is what makes reproducibility cheap: hash the query, seed from the hash, and the eval/exemplar/train split is stable across machines and reruns.

tour.title: Teacher Labeling and Targets
tour.description: The Teacher is a vLLM-served Qwen model on Modal that answers with the entire `teacher_context.md` from Step 3 in its prompt; `cartridge/teacher.py` defines it, an HF-based Scorer for top-k logprobs, and the shared `render()` used by student and base systems alike. `tasks/label.py` streams sampled tasks through the Teacher, validates completions (citations, refusals, item echo), and records labels, while `tasks/targets.py` writes the top-k logprob distributions to Parquet shards on a Modal Volume. `docs/plans/label-queue.md` explains the throughput problem this stage faces and the queue design for keeping the GPU fed.
tour.languageLesson: Distillation targets are top-k logprobs rather than plain text: storing (prompt ids, completion ids, k logprobs per position) as columnar Parquet keeps shards compact and lets the trainer stream them without re-querying the Teacher.

tour.title: Training the Cartridge
tour.description: This is the core idea of the project. `cartridge/cache.py` defines a Cartridge: a trainable KV prefix for the attention layers plus initial conv/recurrent states for the Gated DeltaNet layers of a frozen qwen3_5 model, with prefill initialization and safetensors save/load. `train_distill.py` is Stage 1: self-study context distillation that minimizes cross-entropy against the Teacher's top-k distribution from Step 6, with sweeps, early stopping and a final eval. `grpo.py` is Stage 2: asynchronous GRPO where a generation thread fills a staleness-aware buffer and the trainer applies a clipped importance-ratio loss; `evals.py` supplies the grounded reward and the base/teacher-ICL/cartridge comparisons, and `tracking.py` enforces W&B naming and GPU-cost budgets.
tour.languageLesson: Only the cartridge tensors receive gradients; the base model is frozen and wrapped in gradient checkpointing. A KV-cache prefix is a parameter-efficient way to 'bake in' a long document: at inference it costs the same as a prompt of that length but needs no retokenization, and the HF `DynamicCache` integration lets ordinary `generate()` consume it.

tour.title: Serving Through LibreChat
tour.description: The trained cartridge and the Teacher are both reachable from a chat UI. `cartridge/serve_cartridge.py` is a deployed Modal class that keeps the base model plus one cartridge loaded per container; `serve/backends.py` wraps it and the Teacher with spawn/get timeouts and maps transport failures to `TransientBackendError`. `serve/gateway.py` is an OpenAI-compatible FastAPI app exposing `/v1/models` and `/v1/chat/completions`, running the blocking Modal calls in threads and retrying transient errors, with `serve/chat_models.py` mapping each exposed model id to a teacher, cartridge or mock backend. `librechat/librechat.yaml` points LibreChat's single custom 'Journal' endpoint at that gateway.
tour.languageLesson: Speaking the OpenAI chat-completions dialect (including SSE `data:` chunks and a final `[DONE]`) is the cheapest way to plug custom models into off-the-shelf chat frontends. The gateway strips think tags and reports usage so LibreChat's UI behaves as if talking to a hosted model.

tour.title: End-to-End Chat Test and CI
tour.description: `docs/plans/librechat.md` is the contract for the stack in Step 8 (ports, keys, component ownership, done criteria). `e2e/librechat.spec.ts` proves it works: a Playwright test logs into LibreChat, selects the Journal endpoint, and sends the three fixture questions from `e2e/fixtures/tasks.json`, asserting a reply for each. The GitHub Actions workflow runs that suite on every push and PR and uploads the HTML report, and `tests/test_gateway.py` covers the gateway's routing, streaming and retry behavior without a browser.
tour.languageLesson: GitHub Actions workflows declare `on:` triggers, `jobs:` that run in parallel, and `steps:` that run in sequence; `actions/upload-artifact` with a retention window is the idiom for keeping Playwright's HTML report around for debugging flaky runs.

tour.title: Test Suite and Reports
tour.description: The pipeline is unit-tested without GPUs or a database: `tests/test_cartridge_train.py` checks the distillation loss against teacher top-k, cartridge-only gradients and checkpointing parity on a tiny model, while `tests/test_cartridge_tasks_cli.py` exercises the whole tasks CLI against a FakeStore and FakeTeacher. Finish with the written record: `docs/report/summary.md` is the team-lead review answering ten questions about the pipeline (cold start, storage, cache size, metrics, scoring, orchestration), and `docs/report/recipe.md` frames it as an ML system design with success metrics, infrastructure and risks.
tour.languageLesson: Fakes over mocks: a hand-written FakeStore implementing the same functions as store.py lets end-to-end CLI tests run in milliseconds and read like the real flow, whereas patching individual SQL calls would couple tests to implementation details.
